summary: Per-instance text holder: stores one string locally, with a Length output and optional latch-until-Set behaviour.
description: String holds a single text value that belongs to this node instance alone — it is not named or shared (for an app-wide named value use Variable2). The `value` input sets it and `savedValue` (Value) reads it back; `length` always reports the stored string's character count. While the `saveValue` (Set) signal input is unconnected, values written to `value` apply immediately; once `saveValue` is connected the node latches: incoming values are held pending and only applied when Set fires — the idiomatic way to snapshot a text field at the moment of a click. Incoming values are cast with JavaScript String(). `changed` fires only when the stored value actually changes; `stored` fires after every Set trigger.
whenToUse: Use it to hold or snapshot local text: capture a Text Input's current value on submit, keep a reusable literal in one editable place, or derive `length` for validation. For text shared across components use Variable2 + Set Variable; for computed text use an Expression.

ports.value: String value input. Applies immediately while Value is ticked under Run On Value Change (the default); untick it to hold the value until Set fires.
ports.saveValue: Signal; applies the most recently received `value`, then reports Done or Unchanged. It is purely additive — connecting it does not stop Value writing through; untick Value under Run On Value Change for that.
ports.savedValue: String level with the currently stored text.
ports.length: Number level; character count of the stored string, updated whenever the stored value changes.
ports.changed: Signal; fires only when the stored value actually changes.
ports.done: Signal; a Set stored a value the Variable was not already holding.
ports.unchanged: Signal; a Set stored the value it already held, so nothing changed. ⚠️ With Value left ticked under Run On Value Change this is the common case, because Value has already stored by the time Set fires — untick it if you want Set to be the only thing that writes.
ports.completed: Signal; fires after every Set, whatever the outcome. This is what the old `Stored` port meant, and it replaces it. ⚠️ A Value that wrote straight through reports nothing at all — that is not an invocation of Set.

patterns: Snapshot on submit: Text Input `onTextChanged` → `value`, Button `onClick` → `saveValue`; `stored` then triggers whatever consumes the committed text.
`length` → an Expression or Condition for 'minimum characters' style validation.
antiPatterns: Using String nodes in two components to 'share' text — each instance has its own value. Use Variable2 for shared text.
